- The Center for Immigration Studies says it is animated by a pro-immigrant, low-immigration vision that seeks fewer immigrants but a warmer welcome for those admitted.
- Since 1995, Mark Krikorian has served as executive director of the Center for Immigration Studies.
- Mark Krikorian is a regular contributor to National Review and a regular participant in National Review Online's The Corner.
